description: This file defines the em_cmd_ctrl_t class, which inherits from em_cmd_exec_t, and provides command execution and result sending functionalities within a Wi-Fi mesh control project. It includes licensing information, include guards, and references an external control object.

classes.name: em_cmd_ctrl_t
classes.description: A class that manages command execution and result transmission within the Wi-Fi mesh control system, inheriting from em_cmd_exec_t.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a command and stores the result in a buffer.

methods.name: send_result
methods.description: Sends the result status of a command execution.

methods.name: em_cmd_ctrl_t
methods.description: Constructor for the em_cmd_ctrl_t class, initializing the command control object.
